name: Beef-meatball noodle soup
summary: Hủ tiếu bò viên is the downtown noodle VnExpress describes for Châu Đốc mornings and afternoons. The strand is smaller, soft, and chewy, in a broth of pork leg bone, with five or six beef meatballs. A 2023 day also names hủ tiếu, without the meatball, for breakfast on the Hậu landing and at the market. Saigon hủ tiếu is a different bowl.
origin: Downtown Châu Đốc, on VnExpress, 2 Oct 2019. The strand is the local difference that article names.
texture: VnExpress says the Châu Đốc strand is smaller than a Saigon hủ tiếu, and both soft and chewy. The meatballs are crisp and chewy, and smell of beef. A bowl holds about five or six small pieces.
taste: The 2 Oct 2019 broth is pork leg bone, naturally sweet.
howToEat: Breakfast or late afternoon, in the center. Herbs are there if you want them.
VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 names hủ tiếu again for breakfast along the Hậu landing and at Chợ Châu Đốc, and does not repeat the meatball. Both notes stay.
A bowl was printed at about 20,000 VND on 2 Oct 2019. Check on arrival.
where: Downtown Châu Đốc, and, on the 20 Oct 2023 day, the Hậu landing and Chợ Châu Đốc. A house number was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Hu tieu bo vien in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Hủ tiếu bò viên in Châu Đốc is a small chewy noodle in pork-bone broth with beef meatballs. VnExpress also names hủ tiếu at the landing. Check on arrival.
